symptom: MOCATRIZ had strong within-objective controls but no generic pre-execution arbitration for incompatible material actions from concurrent objectives targeting the same resource.
root_cause: The objective-oriented execution model did not yet model cross-objective resource claims, write/write incompatibility, read/write serialization, or coalescing of identical writes.
early_signals: mocatriz_execution.py models one active objective at a time
material-action idempotency prevents replay of one action but not interference between distinct objective/action identities
repository search found no objective-level resource arbitration contract
human_cost: Potential conflicting mutations, duplicate work or unnecessary serialization across autonomous objectives; detected before live multi-objective execution.
prevention_rule: Before concurrent execution, compare material resource claims across objectives. Incompatible writes require arbitration, read/write requires serialization, identical writes require coalescing, and priority alone must not invent authority.
